title.zh: 课堂单人状态未确认时继续复核

purpose.en: Keep a live greatlovemeta.com classroom connected when a presence refresh fails or omits the caller, then retry the check.
purpose.zh: greatlovemeta.com 课堂在线状态读取失败或漏掉当前用户时保留连接，并在下一周期重新复核。

en: Require a successful presence snapshot containing exactly the current participant before the idle prompt or automatic exit.
Retry an inconclusive or failed snapshot without acting on a cancelled guard result.
zh: 只有成功读取且快照恰好包含当前参与者时才进入闲置提示或自动离开。
快照不完整或请求失败时继续复核，不使用已停用保护组件的过期结果。

en: greatlovemeta.com live classroom Group Call and Webinar lone-participant prompts.
zh: greatlovemeta.com 直播课堂群组通话和网络研讨会的单人提示。

en: Reuse the production-verified Mahj classroom adapter of SmartMeeting's guard retry state machine; keep this site's class admission and media publishing behavior.
zh: 复用已在 Mahj 生产验证的 SmartMeeting 提示重试适配；保留本站课堂准入与媒体发布行为。

en: Run behavioral regression, repository tests, TypeScript, lint, production build, shared gates, exact-commit deployment, production availability and Project evidence checks.
zh: 运行行为回归、仓库测试、TypeScript、lint、生产构建、共享检查、精确提交部署、生产可用性及 Project 记录核验。

en: This cross-site correction does not repeat interactive multi-device RealtimeKit tests on every target; media publishing code is unchanged.
zh: 此次跨站修正不逐站重复多设备 RealtimeKit 测试；媒体发布代码未变。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, local membership catalog, login-protected navigation rules, referral identifiers and site-owned SmartPay5 configuration.
Preserve greatlovemeta.com product access, locale routing and site-owned cloud resources.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、本地会员目录、登录受保护导航规则、推荐标识及站点独立 SmartPay5 配置。
保留 greatlovemeta.com 的产品准入、语言路由及本站云资源。

rollback.en: Roll back the application commit; no data migration is required.
rollback.zh: 回滚应用提交；无需数据库迁移。

productionVerification.en: Verify the exact GitHub Actions run, production availability, and matching current Project release record.
productionVerification.zh: 核对精确 GitHub Actions 运行、生产可用性和本次 Project 发布记录。
